source_scope.change: NEW root-managed generic stdlib reader and pure derivation, with optional stdout-only CLI. No product execution, dynamic evidence code import, or input mutation.
Consume the generic result when constructing the current formal_gate. Retain CAS, history, U09 priority and all previous thresholds.
Consume same result and frozen final owners. Preserve default parent_gate_ledger.json derived artifact output and existing console interface.

confirmed_facts: v24_checkpoint.gates currently hardcodes formal_cases_accepted=NOT_DERIVABLE_FROM_STEP_STATE and accepts only statuses/plans, so it has no independent evidence context.
parent_gate_ledger currently hardcodes per-parent formal_cases_accepted=[] and recursively takes the first plan case_id owner instead of frozen final ownership.
parent_gate_ledger writes its JSON report despite describing itself as read-only. Preserve that interface: read-only means authoritative inputs unchanged, output is disposable derived data.
Current frozen contracts agree on 42 unique formal cases and 22 parent gates. All four ownership views were cross-checked with a read-only Python assertion loop.
W00/W01/W02/W03 currently have accepted parent rows and no owned formal cases. W04-99 is IN_PROGRESS; this review grants no formal acceptance.
GLOBAL_EVIDENCE_V1 requires commit and dirty disclosure, not blanket dirty=false. Code hash/current coverage must still establish exact applicable inputs.
Frozen modes include FIXTURE, LIVE_SERVICE, LIVE_WINDOWS, LIVE_WINDOWS_AND_SERVICE. A generic helper cannot hardcode FIXTURE or infer mode from review filename.
W04 validator README describes implementation conventions, not a new frozen contract. Its source is concurrently under implementation; this design does not certify its current code.

single_source_and_discovery.entrypoint: derive_formal_cases(repo_root, state_path, plan_path) -> structured result; acceptance.json and tasks.json are siblings of pinned plan_path. Pure readonly helper uses explicit fixed paths and snapshots bytes read.
single_source_and_discovery.canonical_state: state_path must resolve to repo_root/execution/v2.4/step_state.json. Validate package/schema/plan hash, unique known step IDs and legal statuses. Do not derive from checkpoint histories, cached ledger, filename PASS, mtime, or recursive receipt glob.
single_source_and_discovery.catalog: Require exactly 42 unique acceptance cases and 22 unique PARENT_FINAL_GATE owners; check acceptance.final_owner_task == tasks.acceptance_final_owners, and exact equal owned sets in tasks.owned_acceptance_ids and owner-99.formal_final_cases. Read command keys/selectors/modes/assertion IDs/expected text from frozen contracts and cross-check bindings.
single_source_and_discovery.catalog_pin: Pin acceptance/tasks/plan to the root-established frozen package hashes. Never accept a modified baseline solely because a caller recomputed its own ref hash.
single_source_and_discovery.registration: For each canonical accepted owner-99 only, read its evidence refs using existing execution/v2.4-relative convention, validate path and SHA, then select known structured independent-review/current-context/root-observed-issuance documents. Each of those three roots must be directly registered in that owner row; the execution index and remaining GLOBAL graph are recursively hash-linked, not inferred from arbitrary nearby files.
single_source_and_discovery.empty_owners: Frozen owned=[] yields valid zero contribution without requiring future formal schema migrations of old accepted parent reviews. It does not change the parent state or reinterpret affected/integration cases as owned.
single_source_and_discovery.unregistered: No owner row, non-ACCEPTED owner, or review not registered on that owner yields NOT_RUN or PENDING_OWNER_ACCEPTANCE with zero contribution. Do not scan an unregistered candidate and count its PASS.
single_source_and_discovery.no_second_truth: No new editable case-status ledger, state fields, schema migration, or case list source. Generic output can be stored only as a derived report; all authoritative evidence refs remain registered in canonical step_state.

evidence_protocol.preferred_profile: Task-neutral researchos.formal.*.v1 data schemas for execution-index, current-context, independent-review, root-observed-issuance, run-receipt, version-manifest, version-vector, command and assertion-results. task_id/step_id are required and verified, never inferred from schema names.
evidence_protocol.bounded_w04_compatibility: If W04 keeps its current researchos.w04.*.v1 documents, recognize only an explicit finite alias table for those exact schemas, constrained to task W04 and identical validated fields. No prefix wildcard, automatic schema string interpolation, arbitrary key adaptation, executable plugin or import of receipt-contained validate.py/gate_driver.py. Future owners emit the neutral profile.
evidence_protocol.minimum_graph: root current context -> exact executor evidence index + root-applicable vector + actual registered dispatch refs; executor index -> four distinct GLOBAL evidence documents for every owned case and exact parent gates; independent review -> baseline + same index + same context; root observed issuance -> exact review + same context + real observed message; canonical owner row -> these immutable roots. No hash cycles.
evidence_protocol.owner_completeness: An ACCEPTED owner must have exactly its frozen owned-case set and all frozen parent gates accepted. Missing case/gate makes that owner PARTIAL and contributes zero; do not award some cases from a falsely complete parent. Other independently valid owners remain countable.
evidence_protocol.case_details: For every case require actual run ID, executor/verifier, interval/environment, actual commit and dirty value, complete root-applicable vector, every frozen command binding, exact nonempty assertion set and exact frozen expected text, actual/status, raw content hash and real locator, negative refusal evidence where required, plus explicit independent semantic judgment for the full frozen scenario.
evidence_protocol.raw_validation: Strict UTF-8/JSON, duplicate keys and NaN/Infinity/overflow rejected; integer exit must be type int, not bool. Refs must be in allowed repo/owner scope, no drive/UNC/escape or escaping link; check bytes and locator existence/nonempty content, treating false/zero as meaningful actual values. Re-read observed hashes at end to reject TOCTOU.
evidence_protocol.semantic_boundary: A generic integrity reader cannot infer C03/A01 or future business correctness from a PASS string or nonempty actual. It verifies the independently issued per-case semantic verdict and linked raw evidence. The independent reviewer must actually inspect/replay the frozen scenario and expected refusals; the helper does not generate this judgment.
evidence_protocol.modes: Each case and each parent gate uses its own exact frozen mode. Do not rank modes or treat LIVE as a universal superset; FIXTURE cannot satisfy LIVE_WINDOWS_AND_SERVICE. Required resource/provenance evidence is linked in the independently reviewed index, not obtained by this reader.
evidence_protocol.unknown: Unknown formal schema or malformed registered review is INVALID with a precise reason and zero owner contribution. Recognized historical non-formal evidence is not a formal candidate; absence of a recognized required formal review on an accepted case owner is PARTIAL, never zero-success.

identity_and_issuance.anchor: Canonical state is the existing root-managed registration trust anchor. File names, integration_codex directory names, observer_id strings or unequal executor/verifier strings alone are not authentication.
identity_and_issuance.actual_delivery: Root must observe an actual independently delivered tool/agent message, preserve its origin metadata/message ID/sender and exact review hash as an immutable evidence artifact, and register an issuance ref after verifying it. The helper checks complete ref/hash/identity/time linkage and matching canonical executor/verifier. It cannot authenticate a fabricated transcript against the external platform offline; this root observation is an explicit process trust boundary, not a claimed cryptographic guarantee.
identity_and_issuance.refuse: Missing real observed issuance, executor-owned review, same resolved executor/verifier, wrong message sender/hash/context, malformed times or missing root registration contributes zero. Aliases for the same actor must be resolved by root observation rather than allowed because strings differ.
identity_and_issuance.ordering: Execution ended <= review issued <= root observation <= canonical accepted_at, consistent with actual records. Receipt-only later commits do not require inventing new execution timestamps.

actual_commands_and_reuse.native_records: Use actual existing dispatcher receipts. The inspected W04 README correctly specifies registered_command_revision is registry file SHA256, not integer registry.revision. Validate original receipt bytes, dispatcher/toolchain/input refs, actual argv/cwd/env names, exit_code and child_exit_code, raw stdout/stderr, exact key/task/selector/mode/assertion set, and link child execution_index_ref to the reviewed index.
actual_commands_and_reuse.direct_vs_registered: Direct candidate execution may supply raw proof but cannot substitute for actual registered dispatch. Reuse references the original proof and current applicability assessment; every required frozen binding must have its actual registered invocation/ref. Two keys carrying the same assertions do not double-count cases or assertions.
actual_commands_and_reuse.binding_currentness: Preserve the execution-time full registry snapshot and SHA. Current applicability compares the exact used command entries, dispatcher, handler inputs and toolchain; an unrelated new registry key/revision does not alone invalidate old cases. If a used entry/handler changes, require root-registered independent applicability refresh or new execution. Never edit old command records to current revisions.
actual_commands_and_reuse.no_execution: The helper never runs Go, product/driver commands, provider calls, old audits or resource probes. It validates already-recorded evidence only.

applicability_and_dirty.coverage: Root independently fixes the full applicable source/input/lock/tool/spec/component coverage and exclusions for each owner. A self-selected list of a few matching files is insufficient. Context must link a root-observed source inventory/coverage record, execution revision/dirty snapshot and current vector; the reviewer accepts that coverage. Exact path-set checks catch relevant additions/removals as well as changed hashes.
applicability_and_dirty.dirty: Do not invent a stricter frozen clean-worktree rule. Dirty state must be an actual boolean and disclosed. Relevant dirty/untracked/deleted inputs require an exact retained byte/path snapshot matching the execution and root-applicable vector; unrelated dirty paths may be explicitly outside the approved coverage. Unknown dirty provenance or uncovered applicable paths yields NEEDS_REVALIDATION, never inferred clean.
applicability_and_dirty.current: Compare actual current applicable bytes/tool identities and covered file inventory to the reviewed vector. An applicable source/input/rule/lock/tool change marks the affected owner NEEDS_REVALIDATION and removes its cases from current accepted count. Preserve its historical review and acceptance registration; never rewrite them to FAIL.
applicability_and_dirty.refresh: A later real independent reuse/applicability assessment may establish unchanged semantics or require targeted re-execution. It must bind new current inputs, original proof, independent reasoning and actual issuance through registered explicit replacement/supersession. A new source SHA with old PASS is insufficient.
applicability_and_dirty.limited_change: Unrelated receipt/checkpoint/feature commits outside the approved applicable coverage do not invalidate proof merely because HEAD or global dirty changed. This avoids perpetual reruns while keeping current acceptance honest.
applicability_and_dirty.global_complete: Only 22 required parents currently accepted and all 42 unique cases currently VALID_ACCEPTED with no unresolved catalog/identity/evidence/currentness issues can produce complete formal gate. Historical lifetime accepted count is not the current total.

supersession.convention: Use a root-observed immutable researchos.formal.review-supersession.v1 evidence document, itself registered in the same owner-99.evidence. Fields: task_id, step_id, replaces_review_refs, replacement_review_ref, reason, observed_at, observer_id, replacement_issuance_ref. All refs contain exact paths+hashes; root preserves actual replacement delivery.
supersession.rules: Validate both review identities, case ownership and scope, replacement issuance, consistent times, no missing edges/cycles/forks, and a unique registered current terminal review. Do not infer replacement from timestamps, list order, current_ filename or overwritten bytes. More than one unsuperseded review for the same owner is INVALID_CONFLICTING_REVIEWS.
supersession.minimal_initial: The first W04 review needs no supersession file. If implementation initially omits supersession support, it must explicitly reject every conflict; it must never silently choose latest. Old receipt bytes remain unchanged.

result_contract.failure_isolation: Catalog/canonical-state corruption yields global INVALID with count zero and structured reasons because ownership is unknown. A bad registered review/ref/mode for one known owner invalidates only that owner; continue deriving all others. Never catch an exception and return success/empty ledger, nor crash the whole checkpoint for one owner evidence issue.
result_contract.unknown_states: Missing/partial/unknown never count. Use INVALID/PARTIAL reason codes, not an unqualified numeric zero that hides failed derivation. Result may report remaining valid accepted IDs alongside integrity PARTIAL/INVALID.
result_contract.input_consistency: Track every read hash, return it and a deterministic dependency snapshot. Expose a recheck-inputs helper so checkpoint CAS checks that graph immediately before write, without rerunning product tests.

consumer_integration.checkpoint: Load the module from fixed repo source path using importlib (v2.4 is not a normal dotted module segment), never a path supplied by evidence. update_file derives once from the same state/plan snapshots, passes structured result to gates/update_value, and expands its pre-replace CAS to the derivation input snapshot. Current formal_gate stores integer count, accepted_case_ids and integrity/reasons. Preserve historical history[].formal_gate exactly as previously recorded, all value thresholds, selection and checkpoint revision rules. Existing unit callers may receive an explicit unknown/no-proof fallback, never a made-up accepted count.
consumer_integration.ledger: Use same generic result for owner list and accepted cases, retaining reachability as a separate diagnostic. Preserve default parent_gate_ledger.json generation and console fields. Match selectors structurally using task/case/key rather than regex presence as acceptance evidence. Keep all_cards_accepted distinct from parent_final_status and formal validity. Mark output derived-only; never read it back as authority.
consumer_integration.frozen_paths: Checkpoint uses existing --plan location. Ledger resolves its existing configured frozen package and verifies exact same pins; do not silently mix external/frozen worktree copies with different bytes. No new install or external dependency.
consumer_integration.dispatch: Root registers these exact three shared source paths under one bounded accounting issue, implements serially, then runs receipt-contained synthetic controls and current read-only derivation. No edits by this reviewer to shared sources/registry/state.

acceptance_plan: Current canonical data before real W04 acceptance derives four accepted parents, zero formal cases, W04 not registered; no product case PASS created.
Synthetic isolated positive registration of a complete owner validates all required evidence and derives its frozen IDs once; mark synthetic output as validator-only, not product evidence.

Synthetic mutations: unregistered review; wrong owner; affected-but-not-owned case; missing/extra/duplicate assertion; exact expected-text mismatch; wrong mode including fixture for LIVE; absent command key; false/nonzero exit; missing raw/hash/locator; unknown schema; NaN/duplicate JSON; identity mismatch; fabricated or missing issuance ref; accepted dependency missing; dirty uncovered; source changed or new covered file; conflicting reviews; malformed supersession and TOCTOU all produce zero for that owner with reason.

Multiple-owner synthetic control: one invalid owner does not erase independently valid others; corrupt frozen catalog/state identity produces global INVALID. Empty-owned historical parents need no migration.
Supersession positive and ambiguity/cycle negative controls if supported; otherwise explicit conflict refusal is required.

Read-only derivation leaves canonical state, commands, old reviews and checkpoint unchanged. Ledger creates only its normal derived JSON artifact. Checkpoint update preserves old history and obeys full input CAS.

Only after actual W04 semantic independent PASS, root observed delivery and exact registration may live current derivation yield A01/C03/C04, count 3/42. The design or synthetic controls must never pre-create that result.
A later applicable input mutation drops current validity to NEEDS_REVALIDATION without rewriting original review; an unrelated receipt-only change leaves proof valid.
completion_boundary: Design only; exact root path registration, implementation, generic integrity validation and actual W04 independent acceptance remain pending.
